description: This file defines the BasketQueryService class, which implements IBasketQueryService and provides functionality to query basket data from a database context, specifically counting total items in a user's basket.

classes.name: BasketQueryService
classes.description: Provides methods to query basket data, such as counting total basket items for a user.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts the total quantity of items in a user's basket by querying the database.
